title: CoASFL: Coupled Consistency Optimization for Asynchronous Split Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.26992v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Split Federated Learning (SFL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training large-scale deep models on resource-constrained edge devices. Although asynchronous SFL alleviates the straggler bottleneck caused by system heterogeneity, it inevitably introduces two coupled dimensions of inconsistency: horizontal inconsistency across clients and vertical inconsistency between clients and the server. These inconsistencies, further exacerbated by statistical heterogeneity, result in biased activation representations, model divergence, and severe client drift. To address these challenges, we propose CoASFL, an inconsistency-aware asynchronous SFL framework that incorporates a dynamic activation merging mechanism and a consistency-aware model aggregation mechanism. Specifically, CoASFL constructs more consistent activation sequences from heterogeneous clients to alleviate horizontal inconsistency, and dynamically adjusts aggregation weights

translated_title: CoASFL：面向异步拆分联邦学习的耦合一致性优化
translated_abstract: 拆分联邦学习（SFL）已成为在资源受限的边缘设备上训练大规模深度模型的一种有前景的范式。尽管异步拆分联邦学习缓解了由系统异构性导致的掉队者瓶颈，但它不可避免地引入了两个相互耦合的不一致性维度：客户端之间的水平不一致性以及客户端与服务器之间的垂直不一致性。这些不一致性在统计异构性的进一步加剧下，会导致激活表示偏差、模型发散以及严重的客户端漂移。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了CoASFL，一种不一致性感知的异步拆分联邦学习框架，该框架融合了动态激活合并机制和一致性感知的模型聚合机制。具体而言，CoASFL从异构客户端构建更加一致的激活序列以缓解水平不一致性，并动态调整聚合权重
tldr: 该论文提出CoASFL框架，通过动态激活合并机制和一致性感知的模型聚合机制，有效解决了异步拆分联邦学习由系统异构性与统计异构性引发的水平与垂直耦合不一致性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoASFL, an inconsistency-aware asynchronous split federated learning framework that mitigates coupled horizontal and vertical inconsistencies through dynamic activation merging and consistency-aware model aggregation mechanisms.
